title: Inertial Thinking
simplified_paragraphs: 一家酒店经营得很好，老板准备开展另外一项业务。由于没有太多的精力管理这家酒店，所以他打算在三个部门经理中选出一位总经理。
老板问第一位部门经理：”是先有鸡还是先有蛋？”第一位部门经理立刻回答：”先有鸡。”老板接着问第二位部门经理同样的问题，第二位部门经理肯定地回答：”先有蛋。”最后，老板对第三位部门经理说：”你觉得是先有鸡还是先有蛋呢？”第三位部门经理认真地回答：”客人先点鸡，就先有鸡；客人先点蛋，就先有蛋。”老板笑了，他决定选第三位部门经理做这家酒店的总经理。
当我们换个角度，跳出惯性思维的限制时，我们就走上了一条新路。
traditional_paragraphs: 一家酒店經營得很好，老闆準備開展另外一項業務。由於沒有太多的精力管理這家酒店，所以他打算在三個部門經理中選出一位總經理。
老闆問第一位部門經理：”是先有雞還是先有蛋？”第一位部門經理立刻回答：”先有雞。”老闆接著問第二位部門經理同樣的問題，第二位部門經理肯定地回答：”先有蛋。”最後，老闆對第三位部門經理說：”你覺得是先有雞還是先有蛋呢？”第三位部門經理認真地回答：”客人先點雞，就先有雞；客人先點蛋，就先有蛋。”老闆笑了，他決定選第三位部門經理做這家酒店的總經理。
當我們換個角度，跳出慣性思維的限制時，我們就走上了一條新路。
pinyin_paragraphs: yī jiā jiǔ diàn jīng yíng de hěn hǎo， lǎo bǎn zhǔn bèi kāi zhǎn lìng wài yī xiàng yè wù。 yóu yú méi yǒu tài duō de jīng lì guǎn lǐ zhè jiā jiǔ diàn， suǒ yǐ tā dǎ suàn zài sān gè bù mén jīng lǐ zhōng xuǎn chū yī wèi zǒng jīng lǐ。

lǎo bǎn wèn dì yī wèi bù mén jīng lǐ：” shì xiān yǒu jī hái shi xiān yǒu dàn？” dì yī wèi bù mén jīng lǐ lì kè huí dá：” xiān yǒu jī。” lǎo bǎn jiē zhe wèn dì èr wèi bù mén jīng lǐ tóng yàng de wèn tí， dì èr wèi bù mén jīng lǐ kěn dìng de huí dá：” xiān yǒu dàn。” zuì hòu， lǎo bǎn duì dì sān wèi bù mén jīng lǐ shuō：” nǐ jué de shì xiān yǒu jī hái shi xiān yǒu dàn ne？” dì sān wèi bù mén jīng lǐ rèn zhēn de huí dá：” kè rén xiān diǎn jī， jiù xiān yǒu jī； kè rén xiān diǎn dàn， jiù xiān yǒu dàn。” lǎo bǎn xiào le， tā jué dìng xuǎn dì sān wèi bù mén jīng lǐ zuò zhè jiā jiǔ diàn de zǒng jīng lǐ。
dāng wǒ men huàn gè jiǎo dù， tiào chū guàn xìng sī wéi de xiàn zhì shí， wǒ men jiù zǒu shàng le yī tiáo xīn lù。
english_paragraphs: A hotel is doing well and the owner is ready to start another business. Since he doesn't have much energy to manage the hotel, he plans to elect a general manager among the three department managers.

The boss asked the first department manager: "Which came first, the chicken or the egg?" The first department manager immediately replied: "What came first, the chicken." The boss then asked the second department manager the same question, and the second department manager answered affirmatively: "What came first, the egg." Finally, the boss asked the third department manager the same question. One department manager asked: "Which came first, do you think, the chicken or the egg?" The third department manager replied seriously: "If the customer orders the chicken first, the chicken comes first; if the customer orders the egg first, the egg comes first." The boss laughed, and he decided to choose the third department manager to be the general manager of the hotel.
When we change our perspective and break out of the limitations of inertial thinking, we embark on a new path.
english_full:
A hotel is doing well and the owner is ready to start another business. Since he doesn't have much energy to manage the hotel, he plans to elect a general manager among the three department managers.

The boss asked the first department manager: "Which came first, the chicken or the egg?" The first department manager immediately replied: "What came first, the chicken." The boss then asked the second department manager the same question, and the second department manager answered affirmatively: "What came first, the egg." Finally, the boss asked the third department manager the same question. One department manager asked: "Which came first, do you think, the chicken or the egg?" The third department manager replied seriously: "If the customer orders the chicken first, the chicken comes first; if the customer orders the egg first, the egg comes first." The boss laughed, and he decided to choose the third department manager to be the general manager of the hotel.

When we change our perspective and break out of the limitations of inertial thinking, we embark on a new path.
